summary: Iteration 2 frontend testing complete — all 4 new features (Tafsir modal, Qibla compass, Azkar full inline verses, PWA service worker) work as expected. 100% pass on UI/integration testing.
critical_code_review_comments: QuranScreen.tsx is 1463 lines — strongly recommend splitting into smaller modules (e.g., extract verse-renderer, bookmark panel, action bar, modals). Above the 700-line guideline.

Minor: synthetic touchend dispatch surfaced a PageError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading clientX)' from a touchend handler that reads e.changedTouches[0] without a guard. Real device events always include the touch, but recommend adding a safety check around handleTouchEnd/handlePinchEnd to avoid runtime errors on edge dispatch.
TafsirModal correctly caches in localStorage with 30-day TTL and has working fallback to quranenc.com — well structured.
Qibla bearing math verified against Cairo reference: 136.1° matches expected; distance 1,287 km matches expected. Good.
Service worker registration in main.tsx happens on window 'load' event — works, registered & activated successfully on reload.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 features fully verified end-to-end via Playwright + real external API hits. Tafsir uses api.alquran.cloud live (returned 435-char Arabic text for 1:1). Qibla bearing math verified (Cairo => 136.1°, 1287 km). SW registered/active. Azkar source file (/app/frontend/src/data/azkar.ts) confirmed clean of any '...' truncations via grep. To re-trigger long-press in QuranScreen, MUST dispatch native TouchEvent with a Touch object (mouse won't fire onTouchStart/onTouchEnd). Use the burger menu (data-testid='azkar-menu-btn') to switch azkar categories — direct text=النوم only works after opening that drawer.
rca of the issue: No issues found. One non-blocking note: dispatching a bare TouchEvent without changedTouches[0] triggers a PageError in QuranScreen's touchend (used for swipe/pinch); benign in real usage but worth a defensive null-check.
